sections.titleHtml: No retainers. No vague promises. No surprises.
sections.lede: PR has a reputation problem: monthly retainers, invisible work, reports full of “activity.” We run it differently, you know exactly what you are getting before you spend a rupee.
items: The outlet mix is mapped and agreed before you commit
Every story is written for you, nothing goes out without your sign-off
You get every live link in a proof report, ready to share
Placements are permanent, indexed on Google, citable by AI platforms
No long lock-ins, engage per placement or per campaign

items.q: How does PR affect performance marketing?
items.a: Branded search goes up and cold traffic converts better, coverage gives your ads a trust floor. Many clients see retargeting improve first.

items.q: We are a small brand. Too early?
items.a: Founder stories work at any size, and early coverage compounds longest, because it keeps ranking as you grow.

items.q: Can you cover a product launch?
items.a: Yes, launch coverage timed with your campaign, plus social placements the same week.
